# LOLM

LOLM is an open-source local AI agent. The public website is documentation
only and does not execute prompts, code, sandboxes, or artifacts.

## Install

    npm install -g lolm-cli
    lolm setup
    lolm

## Source and documentation

- Source: https://github.com/TheArtOfSound/LOLM
- Install: https://lolm.imagineqira.com/install.html
- CLI docs: https://lolm.imagineqira.com/docs.html
- Research: https://lolm.imagineqira.com/research.html
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/lolm-cli

## Product boundary

- Execution happens through the local `lolm` command.
- Users bring their own provider key or use Ollama.
- The local NFET graft measures entropy, hidden drift, gate balance, regime
  entropy, and trained control-head logits.
- The website exposes no public agent execution or purchasing workflow.
